\begin{example} \end{example}[Complex Projective Spaces]1. chC:C.19↗ ex:real-projective-spaces

Similarly, the $n$-dimensional complex projective space, denoted by $\mathbb {CP}^n$, is the set of 1-dimensional complex subspaces of $\mathbb {C}^{n+1}$, identified with the orbit space of $\mathbb {C}^{n+1} \setminus \{ 0\} $ under the $\mathbb {C}^*$-action given by $\lambda \cdot z = \lambda z$. The same argument as in the preceding example shows that this action is smooth, free, and proper, so $\mathbb {CP}^n$ is a smooth $2n$-dimensional manifold and the quotient map $\pi : \mathbb {C}^{n+1} \setminus \{ 0\} \to \mathbb {CP}^n$ is a smooth submersion. \end{example}
